`sqlpipe v2.0` Release Notes

`sqlpipe v2.0` is available. This release contains breaking API changes, a new flag, and faster Parquet writes.

## Performance improvements

Parquet writes are 40% faster in `sqlpipe v2.0`.

## New features

You can use the new `--incremental` flag to process new data. If you set this flag, `sqlpipe` reads only records that changed since the last run.

## Breaking API changes

The update splits the `name` field in the `/v2/users` endpoint into `first_name` and `last_name`. The single `name` field no longer exists.

If you read data from the `/v2/users` endpoint, complete these steps:
1. Update your client code to read `first_name` and `last_name`.
2. Test your client application in a test environment.
3. Deploy your updated client code.

Make sure that your client code works with the new fields before you upgrade `sqlpipe`.
